hero.title: Companies and teams
hero.subtitle: Team building, retreats, film and photo shoots and content recording in a private, versatile rural setting.

intro: Los Collados is the right stage for small and medium-sized companies looking for somewhere different: away from city noise, with privacy, nature and the facilities to work, create and connect as a team.

blocks.title: Team building and retreats
paragraphs: Indoor and outdoor spaces for group work, informal meetings and team days.
Room to lodge up to 16 adults and to organise extra activities on the estate and around it.

blocks.title: Film shoots, photo shoots and content
paragraphs: A cinematic landscape of La Mancha: plains, olive trees, rural architecture and natural light.
Ideal for filming, photo shoots, podcasts and audiovisual production for brands that want authenticity.

featuresTitle: Why Los Collados for your company

features.title: Privacy
features.description: A secluded estate, perfect for sessions without interruption. Exclusive use of the whole estate is available.

features.title: Versatility
features.description: Welcoming interiors and wide outdoor spaces for any format.

features.title: Lodging included
features.description: Your team can stay overnight in the bungalows after the day.

features.title: Dining
features.description: Menus for groups and catering breaks during production.

cta.title: Request a tailor-made quote
cta.text: Tell us about your project (team, dates, type of activity) and we will send you a personal proposal.

form.intro: Film and photo shoots, team building, retreats or a day on the estate. Please give dates, team size and guest numbers.
